The Mechanics Guide is a window which can be opened to view explanations of mechanics.

## Mechanics Guide Interface[]

A mockup of the Mechanics Guide posted on the official forum.

The Mechanics Guide has a categorized list of topics on the left, with a scroll bar to the right of these topics.

Information regarding the selected topic - including a related formula, where applicable - is displayed on the right.
